name: Golden Saint
notes: While these daedra usually wear Golden Saint Style, those present in Fargrave wear the following motif combination: Divine Prosecution Medium Helm Shield and Weapons, Silken Ring Heavy Chest and Medium Shoulder, Deadlands Gladiator Heavy Legs, and Storm Lord Boots.
summary: Golden Saints, also called the Aureal, are a haughty, golden-skinned race of Daedra in service to Sheogorath. Like most NPC enemy types, there are many different classes of Saints and they are often found in complementary groups. A Golden Saint Costume can be unlocked by acquiring 20 Champion points. For more information, please see the Lore article.
